buttonHint: Reads the melody and proposes a chord for each measure; you review and adjust them before saving
saveFirst: Saving your changes, then suggesting chords (the AI reads the saved score)…
generatedDescReplace: Key of {{key}}, {{count}} chords replacing the old ones
failed: Could not suggest chords, please try again
cancelled: The chord suggestion task was cancelled

dialog.title: Suggest chords
dialog.hint: The AI reads the melody and places chords in measures without chords. Every run the AI "thinks" again, so you get a different accompaniment, with up to 3 options A, B, C to choose from. The AI chords appear in the editor (highlighted) for you to adjust and save.
dialog.closeHint: You can hide this dialog; the suggestion is still created and will appear in the Suggestions tab.
dialog.harmonizedTitle: Every measure already has a chord
dialog.harmonizedHint: Do you want to change the existing chords? The AI will drop all current chords and suggest new ones for the whole piece; you still review them before saving.
dialog.clearAllHint: Remove every chord from the score in the editor (unsaved, Ctrl+Z to undo)
dialog.lockedHint: Options with a lock need a higher plan. Select one to see which plan includes it.
dialog.melodyHint: The AI reads this part to place chords; the chords are written onto the part you pick.
dialog.measures: This score has {count} measures · your plan suggests chords for up to {limit} measures at a time
dialog.measuresOver: This score has {count} measures, over your plan's limit of {limit}. Upgrade to get chords for the whole piece.
dialog.measuresOverHint: The score is longer than your current plan allows
dialog.quota: {left}/{limit} chord suggestions left this month · {options} options each

NATURAL.name: Natural
NATURAL.description: Let the AI pick the chords that fit the melody best

SIMPLE.name: Simple
SIMPLE.description: Prefers major and minor triads; good for beginners

COLORFUL.name: Colourful
COLORFUL.description: Adds colour chords such as maj7, m7, sus, 6

JAZZY.name: Sevenths / Jazz
JAZZY.description: Prefers 7, maj7, m7 and extended 9, 11, 13 chords

taskErrors.CHORD_NO_MELODY: The score has no melody to harmonise
taskErrors.CHORD_ALREADY_HARMONIZED: Every measure already has a chord; nothing new to suggest
taskErrors.AI_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service is unavailable, please try again later
taskErrors.TASK_TIMEOUT: Chord suggestion took too long and was stopped, please try again
taskErrors.JOB_REJECTED: The score could not be read for chord suggestion
taskErrors.CHORD_NO_CHANGE: The AI suggested exactly the current chords; nothing changed
taskErrors.CHORD_TOO_LONG: The score is too long to harmonize at once (about 256 measures of 4/4 at most)
taskErrors.CHORD_NO_CHORDS: The AI could not place any chord on this melody; try another style or density

draft.listenHint: Plays the score with the chords of the option you are viewing, from the selected measure (from the start if none)
draft.legend: Chords highlighted in yellow on the score were added by AI. Click a chord below to jump to it, double-click to edit.
draft.discardMessage: AI chords you have not touched will be removed from the score and the suggestion closed. Chords you edited are kept.
draft.resumeMessage: This score still has an AI chord suggestion that was not applied (created {time}). Load it again to review and adjust? Choose "Later" to keep it; reopen it from the Suggest chords button.
draft.loading: Loading AI chords into the score…
draft.loaded_one: Added {count} AI chord as a draft. Review it, edit if needed, then Save.
draft.loaded_other: Added {count} AI chords as a draft. Review them, edit if needed, then Save.
draft.appliedFailed: The score was saved but the suggestion could not be closed; you can close it in the Suggestions tab
draft.cannotDraft: This suggestion can't be opened in the editor, showing the review page instead
draft.outdated: The score has a newer version than this suggestion, review it on the suggestion page
draft.nothingNew: The suggestion has no new chords compared with the open score
draft.blocked: Someone else is editing some of these measures, so the AI chords could not be loaded yet
draft.loadFailed: Could not load the chord suggestion
draft.openInEditorHint: Load these chords into the editor as a draft so you can adjust them before saving
draft.removeHint: Delete chord {chord} from this note (Ctrl+Z to undo)
draft.optionsHint: Each option is a different accompaniment. Switching replaces the AI chords on the score (Ctrl+Z to go back).
draft.optionBest: Option A: the AI's best fit

clear.title: Delete all chords?
clear.message: All chords ({count}) will be removed from the score. The change is not saved yet; you can undo it with Ctrl+Z.
clear.done: Deleted {count} chords. Press Save to keep the change.
clear.none: The score has no chords yet
clear.blocked: Some measures are being edited by someone else, so the chords could not be deleted yet; try again later
